description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultNotesRepository class, verifying note creation, deletion, synchronization with remote API, conflict resolution, preservation of metadata, and reactive search functionality.

classes.name: DefaultNotesRepositoryTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of DefaultNotesRepository, including CRUD operations, synchronization, conflict resolution, and reactive search.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes in-memory database, API mock, and repository before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the database after each test.

methods.name: create_updates_flow_and_persists
methods.description: Verifies that creating a note updates the observed flow and persists in the database.

methods.name: delete_tombstone_removes_from_observed_list
methods.description: Checks that deleting a note removes it from the observed list.

methods.name: sync_marks_dirty_clean_and_uploads_to_api
methods.description: Ensures that sync uploads notes to the API and that the local and remote data are consistent.

methods.name: conflict_last_write_wins_prefers_newer_updatedAt
methods.description: Tests conflict resolution based on the most recent update timestamp.

methods.name: update_preserves_createdAt_and_marks_dirty
methods.description: Verifies that updating a note preserves its creation timestamp and marks it as dirty.

methods.name: search_is_reactive_and_filters_by_title_or_content
methods.description: Ensures that search is reactive and filters notes based on title or content.
